summary: Stevens County lookout on the Spokane Reservation: 83-ft steel tower and L-4 cab dated 1936, abandoned 1950s, tower gone by 1990; FFLOS-registered 2012.

visit.trail_note: WillhiteWeb: a dirt road from Wellpinit works up to the summit; only one spot would be tough for a standard vehicle

events.note: Register and Firelookout date the 83-foot tower and L-4 cab to 1936; WillhiteWeb says the 1936 lookout may have been the cab alone

Tower gone by 1990; the sources do not say how or when it came down
Registered December 17, 2012 as US 1526, WA 426; nominated by Ray Kresek

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Register and Firelookout describe the 83-foot tower and the L-4 cab together, dated 1936. WillhiteWeb says the record is unclear and the 1936 station may have been the cab alone. The story gives both readings.

Register and Firelookout say the tower and cab were abandoned in the 1950s. WillhiteWeb says the cab was abandoned in the 1950s and that the steel tower was still standing in 1979. The story reports both.
Register and Firelookout give 2,942 ft (897 m); WillhiteWeb gives 2,939 feet. The brief's 896.7 m matches the register figure.

notes_for_editor: Brief says access 'permission' but no source read says that, so facts.access is omitted; the reservation context may matter, so please check tribal rules before publishing. The only description of the site today is one undated WillhiteWeb visit. Brief has no height; added 25.3 m from the 83-ft tower. One WebSearch used; it surfaced no new Sherwood source.
